format: Studio / Custom: refund limits and over-refund prevention
requirement: Refunds are capped per entry line (net of discounts) and per order; fee lines are refundable separately; repeated and concurrent requests cannot exceed the caps; requests are idempotent.

implementation.symbol_or_migration: _r2_order_line_caps, _r2_validate_lines, request_competition_order_refund (event_orders FOR UPDATE), unique refund_request_id and stripe_refund_id

enforcement_point: Database ledger, row lock on the order, Stripe idempotency key comp-refund:<requestId>.

tests.name: line cap and requested holds its cap

interpretation_notes: Inspected: held amounts (requested, pending, requires_action, succeeded) count against line and order caps under an order row lock. No two-session concurrency test for the request RPC; Dashboard refunds are recorded without a cap check (R13-F6); stale requested rows hold caps (R13-F5). DanceFlow policy, never a governing-body requirement. Read-only inspection; the SQL suites named were NOT executed by this session (PENDING).
decision_refs: OD-01 (PR 832): never described as a governing-body rule
